name: Protagonist
source:
The protagonist is a restless, loyal smart-arse with a wandering eye and a good heart—he jokes his way through tension but shows up when it counts.

A cheeky, observant romantic who’s more protective than he lets on; impulsive at times, but emotionally present and learning where his lines are.
